verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt containing agent-directed instructions. They also confirm a Markdown rendition of the Treasury docs (treasury.md), and many Treasury doc pages are served as .md files, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/agent-docs offering and confirmation that llms.txt indexes the Treasury-specific pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
